note: What a server sends when a unit comes into what one client can see. The header names the unit this is about.

bits.name: size
bits.note: How many bytes the messages below occupy in total.

fields.name: messages
fields.note: Whole messages of the same family, each behind its own length, that a client acts on as though they had arrived on their own.

fields.name: vitals
fields.note: The unit's health. A server sends this message without it too, ending after the carried messages.

fields.name: maxHealth
fields.note: What the unit's health tops out at.
